title: Charming renovated bungalow
description:
Charming renovated bungalow located in hip East Nashville. The neighborhood is quiet, family friendly close to coffee shops, great restaurants, unique shops and art galleries. Close to all Music City has to offer.

The space
The space is open and comfortable with a gourmet kitchen that opens to a screened in porch. The porch is a great place to fall asleep on the comfy large sectional couch. There are two bedrooms with comfortable queen beds. One bedroom is an on suite with a full bathroom and a kitchenette. The on suite has a wrap around deck with a keyless lock that goes out to the deck.

Guest access
Guest will have access to the downstairs only. The entrance to the downstairs is totally separate from the upstairs. The apartment upstairs has its own outside private entrance on the driveway side. The guest upstairs and downstairs don’t share anything.

Other things to note
This is a quiet family friendly neighborhood so please be respectful of the neighbors and no loud noise after 10:PM.
